ValidationRule.description:
Prevent the ability to edit the "ConnectWise Integration" for non specific Users
JIRA Ticket: AEOM-63
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED( ConnectWise_Integration__c ), ConnectWise_Integration__c = TRUE, $User.Edit_CW_Integration__c = FALSE, NOT($Permission.BypassValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Access required to edit this field
